title: Figure 10: Schematic of a RADAR System Tracking a Hypersonic Vehicle
description: Schematic of a pedestal-mounted 'Radar Dish' emitting 'Transmitted Energy' toward a yellow 'Hypersonic Vehicle', with 'Reflected Energy' returning. Labels include 'Velocity Vector', angle θ to the 'Radial direction', and 'R = radial distance'. The page also gives the RADAR equation (15) for received power.
